title: FR-1: Asset catalog listing types
description:
Implement support for all listing types in the marketplace: Agent, Tool/MCP Server, Model, Workflow Template, Evaluator/Test Suite, Connector (OpenAPI). Each type needs a distinct card UI and metadata schema.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:marketplace
priority: high

title: FR-2: Marketplace search, filter, and compare
description:
Build search bar with full-text + faceted filtering (category, tags, domains, compatibility, compliance tier). Add asset comparison view for side-by-side evaluation.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:marketplace
priority: high

title: FR-3: Asset detail page
description:
Build asset detail page showing: version/changelog, publisher identity, licensing/terms, required dependencies (models, tools, MCP servers), supported deployment mode (SaaS/PaaS), telemetry/evaluation artifacts, and basic risk notes.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:marketplace
priority: high

title: FR-4: Asset ratings and usage metrics
description:
Implement ratings (1-5 stars with reviews) and usage metrics display on asset cards and detail pages. Start with internal metrics only.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:marketplace
priority: medium

title: FR-5: Add to workspace/project flow
description:
Implement 'Add to workspace' CTA that pulls a selected asset into a user's Foundry Project. Should handle dependency resolution and version pinning.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:marketplace
priority: high

title: FR-9: Visual orchestration canvas
description:
Build React Flow-based visual canvas for composing multi-agent workflows. Node types: agents, tools/MCP servers, model deployments, retrieval/knowledge, evaluators, guards, human-in-the-loop. Edges: message flow, control flow, data flow. Support variables/context mapping between nodes.

labels: gt:task, sprint:1, component:orchestrator
priority: critical

title: FR-10: Stateful multi-agent workflow execution
description:
Implement stateful execution engine for multi-agent workflows. Needs checkpoint/resume support, execution history, and real-time progress display. Integrate with Azure AI Foundry Agent Service.

labels: gt:task, sprint:2, component:orchestrator
priority: critical

title: FR-6: Publisher onboarding and verification
description:
Build publisher onboarding flow: org identity verification, contact info, publisher keys (API keys for submission). Integrate with Azure Entra ID for identity.

labels: gt:task, sprint:2, component:publisher
priority: high

title: FR-7: Asset submission pipeline
description:
Build submission pipeline: metadata schema validation, security scanning (code/package/container), policy checks (data handling declarations), human approval workflow with reviewer notifications.

labels: gt:task, sprint:2, component:publisher
priority: high

title: FR-8: Versioning and deprecation policy
description:
Implement semantic versioning for assets, deprecation workflow (deprecation notices, sunset dates), and pinned version guarantees for production consumers.

labels: gt:task, sprint:2, component:publisher
priority: medium

title: Journey B: Governance approval workflow
description:
Implement governance review flow: reviewer receives publish request, checks policy compliance/tool permissions/data egress/audit requirements, approves for internal or external distribution. Immutable audit trail via Azure Confidential Ledger.

labels: gt:task, sprint:2, component:governance
priority: high

title: Azure Cosmos DB: data modeling and setup
description:
Design and implement Cosmos DB schema for: assets (partition: tenantId), publishers (partition: publisherId), convoys/workflows (partition: tenantId), audit logs (partition: date). Configure hierarchical partition keys to handle scale.

labels: gt:task, sprint:3, component:infra
priority: critical

title: Azure Functions API: catalog and publisher endpoints
description:
Implement Azure Functions v4 HTTP triggers for: GET /assets, GET /assets/{id}, POST /assets (publish), PUT /assets/{id}, GET /publishers, POST /publishers (onboard), POST /submissions, GET /submissions/{id}.

labels: gt:task, sprint:3, component:api
priority: critical

title: Azure AI Foundry integration
description:
Integrate with Azure AI Foundry Agent Service for: spawning agents from marketplace catalog, executing multi-agent workflows, capturing telemetry/traces to Application Insights.

labels: gt:task, sprint:3, component:ai
priority: high

title: Bicep IaC for full Azure deployment
description:
Write Bicep modules for: Cosmos DB account + containers, Azure Functions (Flex consumption plan), Static Web App or Container Apps for frontend, Azure AI Foundry project, Application Insights, Key Vault, Entra ID app registration. Support azd up deployment.

labels: gt:task, sprint:3, component:infra
priority: high

title: CI/CD pipeline: GitHub Actions + azd
description:
Setup GitHub Actions workflows for: PR validation (lint, type-check, test), staging deploy on merge to main (azd deploy), production deploy on release tag. Include security scanning step.

labels: gt:task, sprint:3, component:cicd
priority: medium
